newsitem.title: VIETNAM: Vietnam trade gap narrows to $223 mln in February.
newsitem.headline: Vietnam trade gap narrows to $223 mln in February.

text.p: Vietnam posted an estimated trade deficit of $223 million in February compared with $420 million in January, the Statistics Department said on Friday.
February's deficit took the cumulative deficit since the beginning of the year to $643 million.
The average monthly deficit in 1996 was about $330 million, giving a record full-year deficit of roughly $4.0 billion.
The Statistics Department's figures showed that imports in February were estimated at $760 million and exports at $537 million.
It said combined January-February exports at $1.117 billion, were up 23.7 percent from the same period of 1996. Cumulative imports at $1.76 billion, were up 19.3 percent from January-February 1996.
